name: Siri & App Shortcuts (iPhone)
desc: Copy needs clinical/legal review. App Intents exposed as App Shortcuts. The My plan intent is offered only while enrolled in ClearAir and opens the ClearAir red-zone plan.

body.text: Labels stay generic so a locked phone doesn’t reveal which programs you use. Turn on Show sensitive details to see program names.
